children: Randall M. Ruhlman, a 10% owner, sold common shares on September 4, 2026 and September 8, 2026. The September 4 sale disposed of 142 shares at a weighted average price of $400.04 per share. The September 8 sale disposed of 5,000 shares at a weighted average price of $407.78 per share. The total reported sale amount was $2,095,705. After the reported transactions, Ruhlman directly owned 446,609 common shares and indirectly owned 561,090 common shares via trusts.
